description: List the user’s own HelloFresh recipe ratings (both rating scales by default: v2, and v3 = 5 stars). Give a week to name the rated recipes on that week’s menu. The planner never suggests a recipe rated 2 or lower. The ratings list’s item shape has not been observed yet, so items without a recipe id and a numeric rating are skipped and counted, not guessed at. Read-only: rating a recipe is not supported.

scale.description: One rating scale only (v3 = 5 stars). Default: both.

week.description: A delivery week (ISO, e.g. 2026-W49): items on that week’s menu are named with their menu index.

name: hf_list_ratings
